name: dialog_history
description: List recent JavaScript dialog events (alert/confirm/prompt) that the page tried to open. Useful to see what message a challenge popped — the agent never sees the modal because rever-browser auto-dismisses, but the content is recorded here. Also queries the in-page history captured by the script override.

name: dialog_set_auto_dismiss
description: Toggle whether native JS dialogs are auto-dismissed. Default true (recommended). Turn off if you want to see real alert/confirm/prompt modals.

name: dialog_clear_history
description: Clear the CDP-side dialog history buffer.

name: dialog_inject_override
description: Re-inject the alert/confirm/prompt override into the active page. Useful if a page replaced window.alert with its own implementation after load.

name: dom_set_attr
description: Set an attribute on the first element matching a CSS selector. Useful for CSS-puzzle challenges (e.g. moving an element via style.left).

name: dom_set_style
description: Set an inline CSS style property on the first match.

name: dom_set_text
description: Set textContent on the first match.

name: dom_remove
description: Remove all elements matching a CSS selector from the DOM.

name: cookie_set
description: Set or overwrite a cookie on the active page. Use to tamper with auth/session/level cookies for testing.

url.description: Cookie URL/origin (defaults to active page origin)

name: cookie_delete
description: Delete cookies by name (optionally scoped to url/domain/path).

name: cookie_list
description: List cookies for given URLs (or the active origin).

name: local_storage_get
description: Get all localStorage keys/values for the active page.

name: local_storage_set
description: Set a key in localStorage.

name: local_storage_delete
description: Remove a key from localStorage.

name: local_storage_clear
description: Clear all localStorage entries for the active page.

name: session_storage_get
description: Get all sessionStorage keys/values for the active page.

name: session_storage_set
description: Set a key in sessionStorage.

name: session_storage_delete
description: Remove a key from sessionStorage.

name: session_storage_clear
description: Clear all sessionStorage entries for the active page.

name: sw_list
description: List Service Worker registrations on the active page (scope, active script URL, state).

name: sw_unregister
description: Unregister a Service Worker by scope. Useful when SW caching interferes with reversing.

name: sw_caches
description: List Cache API entries (Service Worker / fetch caches) for the active page.

name: inject_add
description: Add a persistent JavaScript snippet that will be injected on every page load for matching hosts. Optionally registers immediately on the current page.

name: inject_list
description: List all saved injection snippets.

name: inject_remove
description: Remove an injection snippet by ID.

name: inject_toggle
description: Enable or disable an injection snippet.

name: inject_run_now
description: Run a one-shot JavaScript snippet in the current page immediately (not persisted).

name: vision_judge
description: Capture a screenshot of the current page and ask a vision model to judge it. Use for things the accessibility snapshot cannot show: whether an action visually succeeded (did the search run? did results render?), whether a modal/captcha/ad overlay is blocking the page, reading text baked into images/canvas, or locating an element visually. Returns the model's answer as text. Uses Claude if an Anthropic key is set, otherwise OpenAI.

question.description: What to decide from the screenshot, e.g. "Did the search for 오늘 날씨 actually run and show results?" or "Is anything covering the search box?"

model.description: Optional vision model override for the selected provider (default: claude-sonnet-5 for Anthropic, gpt-4o for OpenAI).

name: override_add
description: Register a local override: when a URL matching `urlPattern` is requested, fulfill it with `body` (or contents of `file`) instead of hitting the network. Equivalent to DevTools "Local Overrides". Use to neutralize anti-bot scripts, replace a bundle with a beautified copy, or patch a comparison.

file.description: Local file path to load as the body (mutually exclusive with body)

name: override_list
description: List active local overrides.

name: override_remove
description: Remove a local override by ID.

name: list_downloads
description: List files the page downloaded (newest last): filename, url, mime, bytes, state (progressing/completed/cancelled/interrupted) and savePath. Downloads are saved to ~/Downloads/Rever without a save dialog unless the user turned on "ask where to save".

name: wait_for_download
description: Wait until a download finishes and return it (savePath, bytes, state). Call right after the click that starts a download. Returns a download that finished in the last 30s if you have not seen it yet, so calling it after a fast download is fine. Each download is returned once.
